title: City Levy Banded by the Average Room Night of a Hotel Stay
content:
The city levy carried on the statutory line for the last night of a stay in the Hotel Rate Plans range is banded by the average room night of the stay, which is the room nights standing on the folio divided by their number and rounded to the cent.

Where that average is at or above 400.00 USD, the city levy is 18.00 USD. Where it is at or above 250.00 USD but below 400.00 USD, the city levy is 12.00 USD. Where it is below 250.00 USD, the city levy is 7.00 USD.

| The average room night of the stay | City levy |
| --- | --- |
| 400.00 USD or above | 18.00 USD |
| 250.00 USD or above but below 400.00 USD | 12.00 USD |
| Below 250.00 USD | 7.00 USD |

*Working the average out, on a hypothetical folio.* Room nights of 410.00, 395.00, 420.00 and 375.00 USD stand on the folio. Their total is 1600.00 USD and their number is 4, so the average room night is 400.00 USD, which sits at the foot of the top band and carries a levy of 18.00 USD. Were the last of those nights 371.00 USD instead, the total would be 1596.00 USD and the average 399.00 USD, which bands at 12.00 USD.

*The lower threshold, on hypothetical figures.* An average room night of 250.00 USD carries 12.00 USD; one of 249.99 USD carries 7.00 USD.
